public.title: Is Empty
public.description: Return true for null, empty strings, arrays with zero elements, or objects with no own keys. Numbers and booleans are treated as empty because this utility measures collections. Supported inputs contain at most 100 array entries per sequence and at most 20 operations or requests per sequence, at most 60 total object properties and array elements in any single JSON value, nesting depth at most 8, strings at most 100 ASCII characters unless specified otherwise, and integers from -100 through 100 unless a tighter or explicit alternate bound is stated. The entire argument JSON encoding is at most 1000 bytes. Nested sequences collectively have at most 100 entries; output snapshots therefore remain bounded. Inputs always satisfy the described shape and bounds.

explanation: Inspect collection length or own-key count while treating scalar noncollections as empty. O(k) time and space for k object keys, otherwise O(1). This JSON adapter verifies observable results; it does not establish built-in-method restrictions, garbage collection, browser behavior or real timer/microtask scheduling.
